text:
maria (PM): ACME asked for a private pilot week of May 18. Requirements: VPC peering, BYOK/KMS+HSM, no public egress for model artifacts, 95p latency <250ms for short prompts, peak throughput ~180 rps, healthcare/HIPAA. Need cross-team alignment on gating criteria.

samir (Runtime): Which model variant? 8B quant affects KV cache and batching. Also we should set a fallback policy to a smaller model if latency breaks.

maria (PM): They'll start with redwood-8b-quant. Fallback to mid-size ok.

oliver (Infra): 180 rps at 95p 250ms means dedicated GPUs or very tuned batching. Questions: dedicated hardware vs shared with strict isolation? Dedicated adds lead time. Need sequence length distribution and concurrency pattern.

kevin (Security): Security asks: BYOK, audit logs retention 1y, SCIM, VPC flow logs, penetration test sign-off. Need design review before prod access.

anya (Eng): Engineering work: private control plane config, bootstrap for model artifacts, canary hooks, prefix/KV warmup. Estimate ~3 sprints + infra prep. Need seeded QA prompt set and human-in-loop for initial canary.

samir (Runtime): I'll own canary rollout and runtime checklist: quant profile, KV warmup, dynamic batching. Canary config proposal: percentage 5, metrics [95p_latency,error_rate,quality_regression], thresholds 95p_latency 250ms, error_rate 1%, quality_regression 2%, step_minutes 30.

oliver (Infra): Ops: peering, firewall rules, GPU allocation (A10G/H100), storage encryption, nodepool autoscaling caps. Dedicated hardware adds ~10 business days. Shared with network isolation ~3-5 days but higher security risk.

kevin (Security): Shared path acceptable only with legal signoff and strong tenant isolation attestation. I'll draft a security design template and schedule design review for Fri.

maria (PM): Proposed pilot gating: 1) Private control plane with VPC peering; 2) BYOK + KMS test; 3) 95p latency <250ms on 90% of synthetic QA; 4) 5% canary + rollback; 5) Security sign-off + pen test plan.

anya (Eng): Add automated regression checks against seeded prompts and small human review during canary.

samir (Runtime): Action: I'll post runtime ticket with checklist and canary config by EOD.

oliver (Infra): Action: spinning up staging peered env now. Alloc ETA 72h for basic setup.

deploy-bot: staging cluster "acme-staging" created in us-west-2.

kevin (Security): Action: opening SEC-8721 for BYOK + audit logs.

maria (PM): I'll create the launch one-pager and loop in legal. Target next sync Thurs for readiness check. Keep posting blockers here. :white_check_mark:
